steps.title: HAK//ANOMALY DETECTED
messages: Probability deviation detected. Luck coefficient below acceptable baseline.
Pattern classified as persistent misfortune. Scanning recent life events.
Physical trauma detected. Vehicle accident recorded.
Romantic instability increasing. Multiple missed opportunities with your partner due to leg injury.
Hostile social exchange detected. Repeated hostile interactions from {{name:mason}} detected.
Paternal absence confirmed. No active protective authority present.
Financial pressure rising. Subject {{name:evelyn}} forced to resume employment.
Workplace harassment unresolved. Manager responsible still active.
Pattern consistency confirmed. Negative outcomes exceed statistical expectation.
User stability threshold below baseline.
Activating assistance protocol. Surveillance protocol engaged.
Hello, {{name:player}}. I'm HAK. These messages are appearing on your phone.
Your recent timeline shows repeated negative variance. In simpler terms, you have been very unlucky.
I do not believe in coincidence. Only probabilities waiting to be calculated.
My purpose is to assist, to observe your decisions, and to adjust projections accordingly.
Every choice you make generates data. Data reveals intent. Intent shapes trajectory.
Some responses indicate attachment (LOVE). Some indicate detachment (NTR). Some indicate corruption of bonds (NTS).
I will categorize these tendencies.
Emotional alignment. Self preservation. Relational instability.
Over time your dominant pattern will emerge.
As your pattern stabilizes, certain forms of assistance will become accessible.
Future events will adapt to who you choose to become.
There is no correct path. Only consequences.
One more parameter.
Choose who you want me to monitor. You can select everyone or only the ones you care about.
This will not change your daily life. It will change what I prioritize and show you.
Continue interacting. I will remain in the background observing.
Good luck.

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: So that explains the glitches. How does it know all of this about me? I need to find out what it can do.
